questions.en: Who established the branch of Anushilan Samiti at Patna in 1913?
questions.hi: 1913 में पटना में अनुशीलन समिति की एक शाखा किसने स्थापित की थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sachindra Nath Sanyal established the Patna branch of the revolutionary organization Anushilan Samiti in 1913. Bankim Chandra Mitra assisted him.
questions.tip: Sachindra Nath Sanyal authored 'Bandi Jeevan' and was a co-founder of Hindustan Republican Association (HRA).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Sachindra Nath Sanyal established the Patna branch of the revolutionary organization Anushilan Samiti in 1913. Bankim Chandra Mitra assisted him.
questions.tip_hi: Sachindra Nath Sanyal authored 'Bandi Jeevan' and was a co-founder of Hindustan Republican Association (HRA).

questions.en: In a certain code, 'ORANGE' is written as 'PQBOFH'. How is 'GRAPES' written in that code language?
questions.hi: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में 'ORANGE' को 'PQBOFH' लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में 'GRAPES' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted by +1: O(+1)=P, R(+1)=Q, A(+1)=B, N(+1)=O, G(+1)=F (wait: G->H, E->F). Applying +1 to GRAPES: G->H, R->S, A->B, P->Q, E->F, S->T = HSBQFT.
questions.tip: Pattern: +1 to each letter. G->H, R->S, A->B, P->Q, E->F, S->T.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Each letter is shifted by +1: O(+1)=P, R(+1)=Q, A(+1)=B, N(+1)=O, G(+1)=F (wait: G->H, E->F). Applying +1 to GRAPES: G->H, R->S, A->B, P->Q, E->F, S->T = HSBQFT.
questions.tip_hi: Pattern: +1 to each letter. G->H, R->S, A->B, P->Q, E->F, S->T.

questions.en: Who among the following presides over a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament summoned by the President under Article 108?
questions.hi: अनुच्छेद 108 के तहत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा बुलाए गए संसद के दोनों सदनों की संयुक्त बैठक की अध्यक्षता निम्नलिखित में से कौन करता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Under Article 118(4), the Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting. In his absence, the Deputy Speaker presides, and if both are absent, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha presides. The Chairman of Rajya Sabha (Vice-President) never presides.
questions.tip: Joint sitting: Summoned by President (Art. 108); Presided by Lok Sabha Speaker (Art. 118(4)).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Under अनुच्छेद 118(4), the अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) of the लोकसभा presides over a joint sitting. In his absence, the Deputy अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) presides, and if both are absent, the Deputy Chairman of the राज्यसभा presides. The Chairman of राज्यसभा (Vice-राष्ट्रपति) never presides.
questions.tip_hi: Joint sitting: Summoned by राष्ट्रपति (Art. 108); Presided by लोकसभा अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) (Art. 118(4)).

questions.en: The concept of 'Fundamental Duties' was incorporated into Part IV-A (Article 51A) of the Indian Constitution on the recommendation of which committee?('
questions.hi: मौलिक कर्तव्यों' की अवधारणा को किस समिति की सिफारिश पर भारतीय संविधान के भाग IV-A (अनुच्छेद 51A) में शामिल किया गया था?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Sardar Swaran Singh Committee (1976) recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties. The 42nd Amendment added 10 duties in Article 51A borrowed from the USSR Constitution. An 11th duty was added by the 86th Amendment 2002.
questions.tip: Fundamental Duties = Swaran Singh Committee (1976), 42nd Amendment, borrowed from USSR.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Sardar Swaran Singh Committee (1976) recommended the inclusion of Fundamental Duties. The 42nd संशोधन added 10 duties in अनुच्छेद 51A borrowed from the USSR Constitution. An 11th duty was added by the 86th संशोधन 2002.
questions.tip_hi: Fundamental Duties = Swaran Singh Committee (1976), 42nd संशोधन, borrowed from USSR.

questions.en: Which was the first State in independent India to be created on a linguistic basis in October 1953?
questions.hi: अक्टूबर 1953 में भाषाई आधार पर गठित होने वाला स्वतंत्र भारत का पहला राज्य कौन-सा था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following the 56-day hunger strike and martyrdom of Potti Sreeramulu, Andhra State was created on 1 October 1953 for Telugu-speaking people by carving out northern districts of Madras State (capital Kurnool). This led to the Fazl Ali States Reorganisation Commission (1953).
questions.tip: First linguistic state = Andhra State (1 October 1953); Fast-unto-death = Potti Sreeramulu.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Following the 56-दिन hunger strike and martyrdom of Potti Sreeramulu, Andhra State was created on 1 अक्टूबर 1953 for Telugu-speaking people by carving out northern districts of Madras State (capital Kurnool). This led to the Fazl Ali States Reorganisation Commission (1953).
questions.tip_hi: First linguistic state = Andhra State (1 अक्टूबर 1953); Fast-unto-death = Potti Sreeramulu.

questions.en: The High Court of Judicature at Patna was formally inaugurated on which date by the Viceroy of India, Lord Hardinge?
questions.hi: पटना उच्च न्यायालय का औपचारिक उद्घाटन भारत के वायसराय लॉर्ड हार्डिंग द्वारा किस तिथि को किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Established under Letters Patent issued by King George V, Patna High Court was formally opened by Viceroy Lord Hardinge on 3 February 1916. Sir Edward Maynard Des Champs Chamier was appointed its first Chief Justice.
questions.tip: Patna High Court inaugurated = 3 February 1916 (1st Chief Justice: Sir Edward Chamier).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Established under Letters Patent issued by King George V, Patna उच्च न्यायालय was formally opened by Viceroy Lord Hardinge on 3 फरवरी 1916. Sir Edward Maynard Des Champs Chamier was appointed its first Chief Justice.
questions.tip_hi: Patna उच्च न्यायालय inaugurated = 3 फरवरी 1916 (1st Chief Justice: Sir Edward Chamier).

questions.en: To whom does the Speaker of the Lok Sabha address his letter of resignation when resigning from his constitutional office?
questions.hi: लोकसभा अध्यक्ष अपने संवैधानिक पद से इस्तीफा देते समय अपना त्यागपत्र किसे संबोधित करते हैं?
options: Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.explanation: Under Article 94(b) of the Constitution of India, a member holding office as Speaker may at any time resign his office by writing under his hand addressed to the Deputy Speaker.
questions.tip: Speaker resigns to Deputy Speaker; Deputy Speaker resigns to Speaker; President resigns to Vice-President.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Under अनुच्छेद 94(b) of the Constitution of India, a member holding office as अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) मई at any time resign his office by writing under his hand addressed to the Deputy अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर).
questions.tip_hi: अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) resigns to Deputy अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर); Deputy अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) resigns to अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर); राष्ट्रपति resigns to Vice-राष्ट्रपति.

questions.en: What is the maximum strength (number of members) of the Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) of Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार विधानसभा के सदस्यों की कुल निर्धारित संख्या कितनी है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) has 243 directly elected seats (38 reserved for Scheduled Castes and 2 reserved for Scheduled Tribes: Manihari and Katoria).
questions.tip: Bihar Legislative Assembly = 243 seats; Legislative Council = 75 seats; Lok Sabha = 40 seats; Rajya Sabha = 16 seats.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Bihar Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) has 243 directly elected seats (38 reserved for Scheduled Castes and 2 reserved for Scheduled Tribes: Manihari and Katoria).
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Legislative Assembly = 243 seats; Legislative Council = 75 seats; लोकसभा = 40 seats; राज्यसभा = 16 seats.

questions.hi: भारतीय संसद के निचले सदन (लोकसभा) में बिहार राज्य को कितनी सीटें आवंटित हैं?)

questions.en: In which year was Patna University, the premier and seventh oldest university of modern India, established by an Act of the Imperial Legislative Council?
questions.hi: इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल के एक अधिनियम द्वारा भारत के 7वें सबसे पुराने विश्वविद्यालय 'पटना विश्वविद्यालय' की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Established under the Patna University Act in October 1917, it initially had jurisdiction over all educational colleges across Bihar, Orissa, and Nepal. (Patna High Court was opened in 1916).
questions.tip: Patna High Court = 1916; Patna University = 1917; PMCH (Prince of Wales Medical College) = 1925.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Established under the Patna University Act in अक्टूबर 1917, it initially had jurisdiction over all educational colleges across Bihar, Orissa, and Nepal. (Patna उच्च न्यायालय was opened in 1916).
questions.tip_hi: Patna उच्च न्यायालय = 1916; Patna University = 1917; PMCH (Prince of Wales Medical College) = 1925.

questions.en: Who served as the first President of the Bihar Legislative Council (बिहार विधान परिषद) when the bicameral legislature was inaugurated under the Government of India Act 1935 in 1937?
questions.hi: 1937 में भारत शासन अधिनियम 1935 के तहत द्विसदनीय विधानमंडल के गठन पर बिहार विधान परिषद के प्रथम सभापति कौन बने थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Following the 1937 provincial elections, Rajiv Ranjan Prasad Sinha was elected as the first President of the newly constituted Bihar Legislative Council on 22 July 1937. (Ramdayalu Singh was elected first Speaker of the Legislative Assembly).
questions.tip: 1937 Bihar Legislature: Assembly Speaker = Ramdayalu Singh; Council President = Rajiv Ranjan Prasad Sinha.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Following the 1937 provincial elections, Rajiv Ranjan Prasad Sinha was elected as the first राष्ट्रपति of the newly constituted Bihar Legislative Council on 22 जुलाई 1937. (Ramdayalu Singh was elected first अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) of the Legislative Assembly).
questions.tip_hi: 1937 Bihar Legislature: Assembly अध्यक्ष (स्पीकर) = Ramdayalu Singh; Council राष्ट्रपति = Rajiv Ranjan Prasad Sinha.

questions.en: Which Constitutional Amendment Act added the Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law) to the Constitution of India in 1985?(1985
questions.hi: में किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भारतीय संविधान में दसवीं अनुसूची (दल-बदल विरोधी कानून) जोड़ी गई थी?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1985 inserted the Tenth Schedule, laying down disqualification of legislators on grounds of defection from their political party.
questions.tip: Anti-Defection Law = 52nd Amendment Act 1985 (Tenth Schedule); Strengthened by 91st Amendment 2003.

questions.tip_hi: Anti-Defection Law = 52nd संशोधन अधिनियम 1985 (Tenth अनुसूची); Strengthened by 91st संशोधन 2003.

questions.en: In the Indian financial system, which apex bank acts as the 'Lender of Last Resort' and Banker to Banks?(
questions.hi: भारतीय वित्तीय प्रणाली में कौन-सा शीर्ष बैंक 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' (Lender of Last Resort) और बैंकों के बैंकर के रूप में कार्य करता है?)
options: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Established on 1 April 1935 under the RBI Act 1934 on the recommendation of the Hilton Young Commission, the RBI regulates currency issue, monetary policy, and acts as the lender of last resort to commercial banks.
questions.tip: Central Bank / Lender of Last Resort = Reserve Bank of India (RBI, established 1935).
options_hi: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: Central Bank / Lender of Last Resort = Reserve Bank of India (RBI, established 1935).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: In a certain code language, 'WATER' is written as 'YCVGT'. How will 'FIRE' be written in that code language?
questions.hi: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में 'WATER' को 'YCVGT' लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में 'FIRE' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pattern is +2 to each letter: W(+2)=Y, A(+2)=C, T(+2)=V, E(+2)=G, R(+2)=T. Applying +2 to FIRE: F(+2)=H, I(+2)=K, R(+2)=T, E(+2)=G => HKTG.
questions.tip: Shift +2: F->H, I->K, R->T, E->G = HKTG.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Pattern is +2 to each letter: W(+2)=Y, A(+2)=C, T(+2)=V, E(+2)=G, R(+2)=T. Applying +2 to FIRE: F(+2)=H, I(+2)=K, R(+2)=T, E(+2)=G => HKTG.
questions.tip_hi: Shift +2: F->H, I->K, R->T, E->G = HKTG.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Who was appointed as the first Governor of the State of Bihar upon India attaining Independence on 15 August 1947?
questions.hi: 15 अगस्त 1947 को भारत के स्वतंत्र होने पर बिहार राज्य के प्रथम राज्यपाल के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Jairamdas Daulatram served as the first Governor of Bihar in independent India from 15 August 1947 to 11 January 1948. (Sir James David Sifton was the first Governor of Bihar when Orissa separated in 1936).
questions.tip: First Governor of Bihar in Independent India = Jairamdas Daulatram (15 Aug 1947).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Jairamdas Daulatram served as the first राज्यपाल of Bihar in independent India from 15 अगस्त 1947 to 11 जनवरी 1948. (Sir James David Sifton was the first राज्यपाल of Bihar when Orissa separated in 1936).
questions.tip_hi: First राज्यपाल of Bihar in Independent India = Jairamdas Daulatram (15 Aug 1947).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Which Constitutional Amendment Act, popularly known as the 'Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam', reserves 33% (one-third) of seats for women in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies?
questions.hi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, जिसे 'नारी शक्ति वंदन अधिनियम' के नाम से जाना जाता है, द्वारा लोकसभा और राज्य विधानसभाओं में महिलाओं के लिए 33% सीटें आरक्षित की गई हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 106th Constitutional Amendment Act 2023 (128th Amendment Bill) inserted Articles 330A and 332A, reserving one-third of seats for women in the Lok Sabha, State Legislative Assemblies, and Delhi Assembly for 15 years, to be implemented after delimitation following the next census.
questions.tip: Women's Reservation in Parliament (33%) = 106th Amendment Act 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The 106th संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम 2023 (128th संशोधन Bill) inserted Articles 330A and 332A, reserving one-third of seats for women in the लोकसभा, State Legislative Assemblies, and Delhi Assembly for 15 वर्ष, to be implemented after delimitation following the next जनगणना.
questions.tip_hi: Women's Reservation in संसद (33%) = 106th संशोधन अधिनियम 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Under which Article of the Constitution of India can the President seek the advisory opinion of the Supreme Court on any question of law or fact of public importance?
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति सार्वजनिक महत्व के किसी विधि या तथ्य के प्रश्न पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की सलाहकारी राय मांग सकते हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Article 143 confers Advisory Jurisdiction on the Supreme Court. The President may refer a question of public importance to the Supreme Court for opinion. The opinion rendered is purely advisory and not binding on the President.
questions.tip: Advisory Jurisdiction of Supreme Court = Article 143; Original Jurisdiction = Article 131; Special Leave Petition = Article 136.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: अनुच्छेद 143 confers Advisory Jurisdiction on the सर्वोच्च न्यायालय. The राष्ट्रपति मई refer a question of public importance to the सर्वोच्च न्यायालय for opinion. The opinion rendered is purely advisory and not binding on the राष्ट्रपति.
questions.tip_hi: Advisory Jurisdiction of सर्वोच्च न्यायालय = अनुच्छेद 143; Original Jurisdiction = अनुच्छेद 131; Special Leave Petition = अनुच्छेद 136.

questions.en: The Article 280 of Indian Constitution is related to
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान का अनुच्छेद 280 किससे संबंधित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Article 280 mandates the President of India to constitute a Finance Commission every fifth year to recommend the devolution of tax revenues between the Union and the States.
questions.tip: Article 280 = Finance Commission; Article 315 = UPSC and State PSCs; Article 324 = Election Commission.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: अनुच्छेद 280 mandates the राष्ट्रपति of India to constitute a वित्त आयोग every fifth वर्ष to recommend the devolution of tax revenues between the Union and the States.
questions.tip_hi: अनुच्छेद 280 = वित्त आयोग; अनुच्छेद 315 = UPSC and State PSCs; अनुच्छेद 324 = चुनाव आयोग.

questions.en: Which of the following statements is true in the context of money supply in India?
questions.hi: भारत में मुद्रा आपूर्ति के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
options: M3 is the most liquid money supply measure.
M2 is the most liquid money supply measure.
M1 is the most liquid money supply measure.
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: M1 is the most liquid money supply measure.
questions.explanation: M1 (currency with public + demand deposits + other deposits with RBI) is immediately spendable and has the highest liquidity. M4/M3 represents broad money with lower liquidity.
questions.tip:
Liquidity hierarchy: M1 > M2 > M3 > M4. M1 is narrow money with maximum liquidity; M3 is broad money.

questions.en:
Who among the following was/were Members of the State Re-organisation Commission (SRC) in 1953?
(1953
questions.hi: में गठित राज्य पुनर्गठन आयोग (SRC) के सदस्य निम्नलिखित में से कौन थे?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The State Re-organisation Commission appointed in December 1953 comprised Justice Fazal Ali (Chairman), K.M. Panikkar, and Hriday Nath Kunzru. All three served as members.
questions.tip: Commission members: Fazal Ali (Head) + K.M. Panikkar + H.N. Kunzru. Since all three appear, select Option (D).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The State Re-organisation Commission appointed in दिसम्बर 1953 comprised Justice Fazal Ali (Chairman), K.M. Panikkar, and Hriday Nath Kunzru. All three served as members.
questions.tip_hi: Commission members: Fazal Ali (Head) + K.M. Panikkar + H.N. Kunzru. Since all three appear, select Option (D).

questions.en: Who founded the 'Sadaqat Ashram' in Patna, which later became the headquarters of the freedom movement in Bihar?
questions.hi: पटना में 'सदाकत आश्रम' की स्थापना किसने की थी, जो बाद में बिहार में स्वतंत्रता संग्राम का प्रमुख केंद्र बना?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Maulana Mazharul Haque founded Sadaqat Ashram in 1921 on land donated by his friend Khairun Miyan along the banks of the Ganges in Patna, and launched the weekly newspaper 'The Motherland' from here.
questions.tip: Sadaqat Ashram served as the residence of Dr. Rajendra Prasad after his retirement as the President of India until his death in 1963.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Maulana Mazharul Haque founded Sadaqat Ashram in 1921 on land donated by his friend Khairun Miyan along the banks of the Ganges in Patna, and launched the weekly newspaper 'The Motherland' from here.
questions.tip_hi: Sadaqat Ashram served as the residence of डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद after his retirement as the राष्ट्रपति of India until his death in 1963.

questions.en: The concept of 'Fundamental Duties' in the Constitution of India was borrowed from the Constitution of which country?
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान में 'मौलिक कर्तव्यों' की अवधारणा किस देश के संविधान से ली गई थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Part IV-A (Article 51A) by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976 on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee, inspired by the Constitution of the USSR.
questions.tip: Borrowing sources: Fundamental Duties = USSR; Fundamental Rights = USA; DPSP = Ireland; Parliamentary system = UK.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Part IV-A (अनुच्छेद 51A) by the 42nd संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee, inspired by the Constitution of the USSR.
questions.tip_hi: Borrowing sources: Fundamental Duties = USSR; मौलिक अधिकार = USA; DPSP = Ireland; Parliamentary system = UK.
